\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=8cm,height=5cm,xmin=0,xmax=1,ymin=0,ymax=4,
    enlargelimits=false,grid=major,xtick={0,.5,1},ytick={0,1,2,3,4},
    axis line style={line width=2pt,dashed},grid style={dashed,gray!50}]
    \addplot[red,line width=8pt,domain=0:1,samples=2] {0};
    \addplot[blue,line width=8pt,domain=0:1,samples=2] {4};
    \addplot[green!50!black,line width=6pt] coordinates {(0,0) (1,4)};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
